Tickets.title: Reports
Tickets.photo: Attach photos (optional, JPEG, PNG or HEIC from iPhone)

ConsumptionInfo.title: Consumption information
ConsumptionInfo.locked: Consumption information is not yet enabled for your access.
ConsumptionInfo.note: Monthly consumption information of your unit based on the values transmitted by the metering service. No statement, no legal effect; the heating cost statement remains decisive.

Meter.title: Report meter reading
Meter.meterIdHint: You find the meter ID in your documents or can ask the management for it.

SepaMandate.title: SEPA direct debit mandate

SepaMandate.confirm: I am the account holder and grant the SEPA direct debit mandate above.
SepaMandate.submitted: The mandate was submitted as a proposal. The management reviews and releases it; the evidence is available under Documents.

access.none: No handover protocol exists for your access.

deposit.notice: Deposit details are only recorded and printed in the protocol; they do not trigger a payment.

read.title: Read view
read.intro: The protocol is completed. This view shows the recorded data; changes are no longer possible.

Notices.title: Notices
Notices.intro: Notices of the management for your properties. A notice is information of the management, not a delivery.

BoardSubmissions.roleNotice: The management submits matters to you as a board member for information or for an opinion. Your vote is information for the management; the order and any payment stay with the management.

Audit.title: Board audit room
Audit.roleNotice: You see the audit engagement, the selected positions and the receipts released for them. The board does not post, release or change any statement. Opening a document is no acknowledgement of the statement.

Audit.noDocuments: No receipts released for the positions.
Audit.questionSent: The question was sent to the management.

filter.label: Filter positions
filter.unfiltered: {total, plural, one {# position} other {# positions}}, unfiltered.
filter.invalid: The filter is invalid, for example the end date is before the start date. All positions are shown.

reports.title: Audit reports and board statement
reports.notice: The audit report is created by the management per version. The board statement is a separate text with time and author. It has no release effect and changes neither the report nor the statement.
reports.history: {count, plural, one {one earlier version} other {# earlier versions}}
reports.statementHint: A new statement replaces the previous text; earlier versions remain traceable in the report.

Audit.costTableCaption: Cost items of the audit engagement

Forms.title: Forms
Forms.intro: Forms of your management, for example applications and requests. Every submission becomes a case you can follow under Reports.
Forms.empty: Your management currently provides no forms.
Forms.submitted: {name} has been submitted. You can find the case under Reports.
Forms.proposalNote: The entries are sent to the management and reviewed there.

Invitation.title: Accept invitation
Invitation.hint: Please enter the invitation code from the letter or the link and choose a password of at least 6 characters.
Invitation.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 6 characters.
Invitation.done: Your access is active. Please sign in with e-mail and password now.

Security.title: Security
Security.intro: Second factor and remembered devices of your access.
Security.totpStatusOn: The second factor is on. A code from the authenticator app is requested at login unless the device was remembered.
Security.totpStatusOff: The second factor is off. You sign in with e-mail and password.
Security.totpEnableHint: With an authenticator app (for example on your smartphone) a six digit code is requested at login in addition to the password.
Security.totpSetupHint: Scan the QR code with the authenticator app or enter the key manually. Then enter the six digit code shown; only then is the second factor active.
Security.totpQrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
Security.totpCodeInvalid: The code consists of 6 to 8 digits.
Security.totpEnabled: The second factor is now on.
Security.totpDisableHint: Enter your current password to switch it off. Remembered devices are removed as well.
Security.devicesHint: On remembered devices no second factor is requested for 90 days. Sign out removes the device immediately.

Pwa.title: Install MH Portal
Pwa.hint: The portal can be placed on the home screen like an app. No data is stored on the device.
Pwa.iosHint: In Safari via Share and Add to Home Screen. No data is stored on the device.

Accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
Accessibility.intro: This statement covers the tenant and owner portal of the MH Verwaltungsplattform. It is a draft under the German Barrierefreiheitsstärkungsgesetz (BFSG) and its ordinance; legal review and sign-off are still pending.
Accessibility.status: The portal is developed against EN 301 549 and WCAG 2.1 level AA. A full conformance audit has not yet been completed. [to be added: result of the external audit]
Accessibility.scope: This statement covers the tenant and owner portal reachable through this application. It does not cover third party linked documents or files uploaded by the management. [to be added: exceptions under § 3 BFSGV]
Accessibility.preparation: Prepared on 27.09.2026 based on an internal self-assessment. [to be added: date of the last review]
Accessibility.contact: We welcome feedback on accessibility barriers in this portal. [to be added: contact address for accessibility feedback]
Accessibility.enforcement: If the response is unsatisfactory, the responsible monitoring body can be contacted. [to be added: responsible enforcement and monitoring body]
